annotations.title: Ask for a referral to a job

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Asks the referrers the user chose (from list_company_referrers, 1 to 5) at the job's company to refer the signed-in user, with a copy of their CV chính (primary CV) and their message. Only the chosen referrers receive it; the first to take it handles it. If list_company_referrers returns nobody, call it without referrer_handles: the request joins the company's waiting list and a referrer who joins later sees it. Two steps: call without confirm_token to get a preview (nothing is sent) and show it to the user; only after the user explicitly agrees, call again with the same job_id, message and referrer_handles plus the confirm_token. A sent request goes to real people and cannot be taken back. Limited to a few requests per week.

confirm_token.description: Omit to get a preview. Pass the confirm_token from the preview, with the same job_id, message and referrer_handles, only after the user explicitly agreed to send.

job_id.description: Job id from search_jobs, get_job or suggest_jobs_for_me.

message.description: The user's message to the referrer, in their own words (why they fit the job). Sent exactly as given; it may be empty.

referrer_handles.description: Handles of the referrers the user chose from list_company_referrers (1 to 5). Only these referrers receive the request; the first one to take it handles it. Omit it only when list_company_referrers returned nobody: the request then joins the company's waiting list.

share_outcome.description: true = the referrer who refers the user is told later, without details, when the user records being contacted, interviewing, an offer or the job in their tracker (never rejections). Default false; ask the user.

name: request_referral

confirm_token.description: Valid 10 minutes, for this user, job, message and chosen referrers.

preview.description: What would be sent (result preview). Nothing was sent yet.

cv_fit.description: The job's must-have skills the CV chính shows or not; referrers see the same. weak = under half.

primary_cv.description: File name of the CV chính; referrers get a copy of it as it is now.

referrers.description: The referrers the user chose, who will be told.

share_outcome.description: Whether the referrer will hear good news later.

waiting.description: True when nobody at the company can be chosen yet: the request joins the waiting list (referrers = 0).

request.description: The request that was sent (result sent).

requests_url.description: Where the user follows their referral requests on techjobs.vn.

title: Ask for a referral to a job
